about:
Bennett Plastics was founded in 1982 in Paterson, New Jersey, just minutes from New York City. The company began as a family-owned and operated business focused on custom plastic injection molding and has remained under family ownership for over four decades.

Today the firm operates a 36,000-square-foot facility where it produces millions of parts annually. All manufacturing is kept in-house, covering plastic injection molding, 3D printing and prototyping, product development, injection mold making, and finishing services. A dedicated team of engineers and technicians manages projects from initial design through full-scale production runs.

The company serves a range of industries including baby products, food service, consumer goods, health and beauty, electrical, industrial, pharmaceutical, and retail markets. Customers rely on Bennett for both prototype development and high-volume production of components used in consumer and industrial applications.

Bennett Plastics emphasizes direct communication, a no-outsourcing policy, and a Fast-Track Mold Insert Program that can deliver molded samples in as little as five weeks. The company also highlights its sustainability efforts, using eco-friendly materials and energy-efficient processes to reduce environmental impact.
